name: PSLV-XL
tagline: ISRO's heavy strap-on PSLV variant — Chandrayaan-1 + Mars Orbiter
description: Four-stage Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle in its extended (XL) configuration: six PS0M-XL strap-on solid boosters with ~50 % more propellant than the standard PSLV. Lifts ~3.8 t to LEO / ~1.8 t to SSO / ~1.4 t to GTO and has carried India's most significant interplanetary missions — Chandrayaan-1 (2008) and Mangalyaan / Mars Orbiter Mission (2013) — from Sriharikota's First Launch Pad. Still active for hyperspectral + radar Earth-observation deployments.
best_known_for: ISRO's heavy-strap-on PSLV variant — launched Chandrayaan-1 + Mars Orbiter Mission
